messages.text: Hello Nadeera, this is Malini from Riverstone Mills in Galle. Your interview for the store counter post is on Tuesday at 10:30 at our branch.
Thank you. Should I bring anything besides my CV?
Bring your NIC copy and the certificates you already sent. The meeting at the Galle branch has no charge.
Do I pay anything for a uniform, a medical, or a seat?
No. Riverstone Mills does not take a registration fee or a deposit. If you join, the monthly salary is LKR 64000, paid by our payroll to your bank after the contract is signed.
I will be at the Galle branch on Tuesday.
